channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Langston Galloway | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Langston Galloway from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Nash on Langston Galloway
item.description:
Steve Nash on whether Langston Galloway will play tonight:

“We'll see. It's tricky. ... We're gonna meet right before the game and go over the game plan. ... Let's see if we get a chance to use him.”

Steve Nash on Langston Galloway, Dec 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on E'Twaun Moore, Jae Crowder, Langston Galloway, Torrey Craig
item.description:
“In the bubble, with the way we handled ourselves, team success comes with individual accolades. I think that is what really happened in the bubble. I saw each and every one of us really grow. We won some games and we started to put the right staff in. That is why we are here, to be honest. Whatever we are doing [now], was built in the bubble. “Winning was contagious and we added pieces like CP, Jae [Crowder], E’Twaun Moore, Langston Galloway and Torrey Craig. Those are guys who have been in the game and played at high levels like this. That is the best way I can think of how I turned my career into a positive one.”

Deandre Ayton on E'Twaun Moore, Jae Crowder, Langston Galloway, Torrey Craig, Jun 23, 2021. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Langston Galloway, Bruce Brown
item.description:
Casey said of Robinson's spotty minutes.

“I tell guys all the time, if an opportunity comes, be ready to step in because you never know,whether it's Bruce Brown, Glenn Robinson, Langston (Galloway). Our guys have done a heck of a job being ready when their number is called.”

Dwane Casey on Langston Galloway, Bruce Brown, Nov 6, 2018. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Omri Casspi on DeMarcus Cousins, Tyreke Evans, Langston Galloway, Buddy Hield
item.description:
“This is an exciting time for Pelicans fans as we continue our quest for long-term success. I know our fans are equally excited to welcome DeMarcus and Omri to our great city. I want to thank Mr. and Mrs. Benson, Dennis Lauscha and Mickey Loomis for their continued support and providing the resources for us to be successful. I’d also like to thank Tyreke Evans, Langston Galloway and Buddy Hield for their professionalism and hard work on the court and in the community during their tenure in New Orleans.”

Omri Casspi on DeMarcus Cousins, Tyreke Evans, Langston Galloway, Buddy Hield, Feb 20, 2017. Source: NBA.com.
